name: Emberfall Godot art style
look: Sunlit storybook realism: bright, soft, stylized-but-lifelike 3D with lush open-world scenery. Clean readable shapes, rich but natural colour, soft light. All designs original to Emberfall.

units.origin: Props and characters: origin at the base, centred. Hand items: origin at the grip, blade/head pointing +Y.

shading.rule: Smooth shading with soft bevels on every hard edge (bevel 1-3 cm on props, 0.5-1 cm on hand items). No toon ramps, no outlines, no flat facets. Colour comes from textures or per-material albedo, not vertex colours, except foliage tint and AO in vertex colour is fine.
shading.silhouette: Chunky, slightly rounded, readable at 30 m. Hand items may be up to 15% oversized versus real life.

pbr.workflow: Godot StandardMaterial3D (metallic/roughness). Textures: albedo (sRGB), normal (OpenGL, Y+), ORM (R=AO, G=roughness, B=metallic, linear).
pbr.albedo_range: Keep albedo between sRGB 40 and 235. No lighting or hard shadows baked into albedo.
pbr.normal_strength: 0.6-0.9 (soft, painted detail, never gritty photo detail)
pbr.detail_scale: Big colour variation (0.5-2 m), soft medium detail, very little fine noise.

textures.format: PNG in the repo; Godot imports as VRAM compressed (BPTC/ASTC). Normal maps flagged as normal.
textures.tiling: All library textures tile seamlessly. Terrain textures cover 2 x 2 m per repeat; others 1 x 1 m.

poly_budgets.export: glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), Y-up, metres, applied transforms

special_materials.metal: metallic 1.0; bronze/steel roughness 0.25-0.3, iron 0.5. Mithril adds emission #2A6FA8 at 0.35.
special_materials.ember_glow: emission from palette.ember with energy 2-4, so glow picks it up
special_materials.foliage: alpha scissor 0.5, backlight #A8D86A at 0.35, two-sided, vertex wind sway
special_materials.water: custom shader: depth tint shallow->deep, soft foam at edges, small waves, roughness 0.05
special_materials.skin: subsurface scattering 0.3, roughness 0.55 (characters thread owns details)

characters: Follow the approved lifelike hero style (character-creator/lifelike-preview). Natural proportions, slightly enlarged eyes, soft skin SSS, clean hair cards. Creatures: original, rounded and appealing, never copies of another game's creatures.
dont: No copying any existing game's characters, creatures, logos or textures.
No outlines, toon ramps or flat-shaded facets.
No baked lighting or hard shadows in albedo.
No photo-gritty detail or heavy dirt; keep surfaces clean and readable.
No pure black (#000) or pure white (#FFF) albedo.
